description:
Create a new Work Log Type in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus for field services. 

Log in as administrator (password: administrator). 
Navigate to the Admin section and find 'Work Log Types' (usually under Helpdesk or General Settings). 
Create a new type with the following details:
- Name: 'On-Site Repair'
- Description: 'Billable time for physical equipment repair and maintenance at client location.'
- Hourly Rate: $150.00

Save the new work log type.
